newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT lifts Philippine shares in early trade.
newsitem.headline: PLDT lifts Philippine shares in early trade.

text.p: Blue chips led by PLDT propped up the Philippine stock market's main index on Thursday, brokers said.
"Market opened up on PLDT, possibly as the market anticipates that it will eventually get approval for a restructuring of its rates," said Joey Roxas, president, Eagle Equities.
PLDT which was up by 35 pesos to 875 pesos in early trade may be seeing accumulation ahead of second quarter results, said Elline Salvatierra, analyst at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.
The main index opened 9.8 points up at 2,839.09.
PLDT was the most active issue in early trade.
Other early gainers included Manila Electric Corp B, San Miguel Corp B and Pilipino Telephone Corp.

"People may be reacting the way they did yesterday as they await the Hong Kong handover and the Federal Reserve meeting. The market may be up early and then down, swinging in a limited range for the rest of the session," said Jonathan Ravelas, head of sales at Asian Capital Equities.
